purpose: Human-recorded Adventure Wales commercial/operator decisions for the command centre. Agents may prepare evidence and options, but must not invent MK decisions or change production operator tiers automatically.

decisionOptions.label: Strategic Anchor
decisionOptions.meaning: Free enhanced treatment because the operator materially improves launch credibility or user trust. Requires rationale.

decisionOptions.label: Premium Sales Lure
decisionOptions.meaning: Build/use a premium-quality preview as a personalised sales asset; do not publish as a free premium listing.

decisionOptions.label: Claimed/Basic
decisionOptions.meaning: Basic verified listing treatment only; no premium placement or unpaid commercial value.

decisionOptions.label: Stub Only
decisionOptions.meaning: Minimal page with claim CTA and restricted public value until operator claims or pays.

decisionOptions.label: Remove/Block
decisionOptions.meaning: Do not publish or progress until identity, safety, closure, permission, or quality blocker is resolved.

decisionOptions.label: Needs Permission
decisionOptions.meaning: Operator/media/source permission needed before content or images can be used.

decisions[].decision: strategic_anchor | premium_sales_lure | claimed_basic | stub_only | remove_or_block | needs_human_permission
decisions[].next_action: specific next step for awcommercial, awbuilder, awresearcher, or awreviewer
